name: Restore Extremity
body:
Discipline Psychometabolism (Healing); Level Egoist 5

MANIFESTING

Display Auditory
Manifesting Time 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range Touch
Target Creature touched
Duration Instantaneous
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Power Resistance Yes (harmless)
Power Points 9

DESCRIPTION

You restore a severed extremity to a creature that has lost a digit, hand, arm, leg, or even its head. This power does not restore life, but it returns a lost extremity to a living or dead creature if the creature is otherwise mostly intact. The original extremity need not be present when this power is manifested; a new extremity is created by the power. If a head is restored to a body, the original head (if not already destroyed) loses all spark of identity, and can be considered dead tissue.
